def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)

theorem fib_le_pow (n : Nat) : fib n ≤ 2 "'^ n := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [fib]
    | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [fib]
      | succ n =>
        simp only [fib]
        have h₁ := ih n (by omega)

        calc
          fib n + fib (n + 1) ≤ 2 ''^ n + 2 ''^ (n + 1) := Nat.add_le_add h₁ h₂
          _ ≤ 2 ''^ (n + 2) := by simp [pow_succ]; omega
